name: קנייה אם יש מספיק כסף
note: Conditional subtraction: new balance after a purchase only if affordable, else unchanged.

name: משלוח חינם מעל 10
note: Threshold test on one input selecting between zero and the other input.

name: יום סוף שבוע?
note: Modulo-7 day-of-week then a range test: flag 15 when day counter d falls on days 5-6 of the week.

name: קנס איחור
note: Compare, subtract, multiply and saturate: days late times daily fee, capped at 15.

name: האם ראשוני?
note: Arbitrary non-arithmetic predicate on one number (lookup table), returned as a 15/0 flag.

name: הביט שבמקום ב
note: Variable-indexed bit extraction, with inputs in the unusual cells 1 and 3.

name: שורש שלם
src: a=>{ let k=0; while((k+1)*(k+1)<=a) k++; return k; }
note: Inverse of squaring found by a search loop, with the single input in cell 3.

name: השוואה עם סימן
note: Signed (two's complement) less-than where 8..15 mean -8..-1, a twist on the unsigned comparison.

name: כמה ערכים שונים
note: Equality and tie handling across three inputs: counts distinct values (1, 2 or 3).

name: סכום סדרה חשבונית
src: (a,b,c)=>{ let s=0, x=a; for(let i=0;i<c;i++){ s=(s+x)&15; x=(x+b)&15; } return s; }
note: Loop whose trip count is an input, with two accumulators: sum of c terms starting at a with step b, mod 16.

name: אותה זוגיות?
note: Parity comparison of two numbers returning a 0/15 flag.

name: נשא בחיבור
note: Detects 4-bit overflow of a+b, returning the carry bit 0/1.

name: שניהם גדולים מ-7?
note: Logical AND of two threshold tests (both inputs above 7) as a 0/15 flag.

name: א ועוד חצי ב
note: Halving one input and adding it to the other modulo 16.

name: סימן ההפרש
note: Three-way compare: 1 if a>b, 15 (i.e. -1 mod 16) if a<b, 0 if equal.

name: מרחק מעגלי
note: Distance on a 16-hour clock: the shorter of the two ways around.

name: החצי העליון של המכפלה
note: High 4 bits of the 8-bit product a*b (floor of a*b/16).

name: הגבל ליד ב
note: Clamps a into the window [b-2, b+2] (window edges cut by 0..15 naturally).

name: מרחק האמינג
src: (a,b)=>{ let x=(a^b)&15, c=0; while(x){ c+=x&1; x>>=1; } return c; }
note: Counts the bit positions where a and b differ (popcount of a XOR b).

name: מחלק משותף גדול
src: (a,b)=>{ while(b){ const t=a%b; a=b; b=t; } return a; }
note: Greatest common divisor by a loop with a decision; gcd(a,0)=a and gcd(0,0)=0.

name: חזקה מודולו 16
src: (a,b)=>{ let r=1; for(let i=0;i<b;i++) r=(r*a)&15; return r; }
note: a to the power b modulo 16 by repeated multiplication, with a^0=1 (also 0^0=1).

name: סובב ביטים שמאלה
note: Rotates the 4 bits of a left by (b mod 4) positions, wrapping the top bits around.

name: חציון של שלושה
note: Median of three: needs max and min (or a sorting network) and elimination.

name: טווח של שלושה
note: Range of three numbers: max of three minus min of three.

name: האם ג בין א ל-ב
note: Inclusive betweenness test where the bounds a,b may come in either order (15=true, 0=false).

name: סכום משוקלל 1-2-3
note: Weighted sum a+2b+3c reduced mod 16, testing repeated addition with wraparound.

key: num3.json|אם א גדול מ-ב אז ג אחרת ב
name: אם א גדול מ-ב אז ג אחרת ב
note: Conditional selection driven by a strict comparison of the first two inputs.

name: רוב אי-זוגיים
note: Majority vote over the parity bits of three numbers (15 if at least two are odd).

name: הקרוב ל-א מבין ב ו-ג
note: Two absolute differences, a comparison, then selection (ties go to b).

name: סכום או גלישה
note: Detect carry-out of a 4-bit addition and return c on overflow, else the sum.

name: מיקום הגדול
note: Argmax of three: return the position (0,1,2) of the largest value, earliest on ties.

name: ספירת ביטים
note: Popcount of a 4-bit number: extract each bit and add them.

name: קוד גריי
note: Gray code: XOR a number with itself shifted right by one.

name: היפוך ביטים
note: Reverse the order of the four bits, needing both left and right bit moves.
